aspect: No body, no proof, no end
description: Without remains there is no moment at which the death becomes a fact. Part of the mind continues to run a search process, sometimes for decades.
energy_note: A door in your head that will not close.

description: Bodies buried quickly, collectively, or in the wrong place, under fire. The survivor carries not only the loss but the sense of having failed the dead in the one duty that was theirs.
energy_note: Failing someone who is already gone.

aspect: Ambiguous loss is its own category
description: 'Missing' is not a lighter version of 'dead'. It blocks grief, blocks inheritance, blocks remarriage, blocks the paperwork of a life, and keeps hope active at full strength indefinitely.
time_note: Often unresolved for the rest of the survivor's life.
energy_note: Hope, running continuously, as an injury.

aspect: The legal machinery makes it worse
description: Declaring someone dead in absentia takes years, requires evidence that does not exist, and asks the family to formally ask for it - to petition, in writing, for their own relative to be declared dead.
energy_note: Filing a form that kills your brother.

aspect: SCENARIO - the phone that is still paid
description: Her son's number has been out of service for four years. She pays the line anyway, so that if it is ever switched on it will still be his.
money_note: Annual cost of a line kept live.
energy_note: A monthly direct debit as a form of prayer.

description: The date arrives every year and produces a measurable physical response - sleep loss, appetite change, irritability - often before the person has consciously registered what day it is.
energy_note: Your body keeps the calendar for you.
